shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin (BTC) dropped below $60,000 amid record November spot ETF outflows ($5.78B) and $6.8B in options expiry.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index hit 'Extreme Fear' at 10, staying below 25 for 16 consecutive days, the longest stretch on record.
Ethereum (ETH) declined under selling pressure from rising exchange reserves and nine consecutive days of spot ETF outflows.
US equities rallied on Black Friday while crypto lagged, hindered by expectations of high US interest rates extending into mid-2027.
Ethereum's 'Glamsterdam' upgrade advances with Hoodi testnet scheduled for December 16 and mainnet targeted for early to mid-January 2027.
